title: leucas cephalotes
intro: Leucas cephalotes, commonly known as Wild Camphor, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucas cephalotes include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include camphor, borneol, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
